summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a transaction in own shares through an existing share buyback programme. On 12 June 2026, the company purchased 4,132,460 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 101.4903 pence per share, with prices ranging from 100.1000 to 102.0000 pence. The shares were purchased under instructions issued on 29 January 2026 and will be cancelled. This open-market repurchase is part of a previously announced buyback programme. The transaction reduces outstanding share count, potentially increasing earnings per share. What to watch: ongoing buyback execution pace and its impact on capital structure.
